title: ὁ λύκος ἔρχεται
learning_goal: Practice present tense verbs of fear and movement (φοβέομαι, φεύγω, εἰσέρχομαι, ἐξέρχομαι) with simple emotional responses and the interjections ἰδού and οἴμοι.
plot: Good animals eat peacefully until they spot Lukos at the window, then flee when he enters the house.

frames.text: τὰ καλὰ ζῷα ἐσθίει τὸν ἄρτον ἐπὶ τῇ τραπέζῃ.
objects: a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden crust torn into pieces
positioning: Panda sits at the table on the left side taking a bite of bread.
Koala sits across from Panda on the right side holding a piece of bread.
Dinosaur sits at the near side of the table with bread crumbs around him.
Glaux perches on the table edge pecking at bread pieces.
The round rustic loaf of bread with a golden crust torn into pieces is scattered across the table center.
motivations: Panda is content and relaxed because she enjoys sharing bread with her friends at home.
Koala is happy and peaceful because she sits with friends eating warm bread together.
Dinosaur is cheerful and satisfied because he munches bread with his companions.
Glaux is calm and pleased because she shares the meal with her friends.

frames.text: ἰδού! ὁ λύκος ἐστὶ κακὸν ζῷον ἐν τῇ θυρίδι!
objects: a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden crust torn into pieces
a small square window with a wooden frame; we have switched to a very wide angle shot to reveal the window off to the right hand side
positioning: Panda drops her bread piece and stares wide-eyed at the window with alarm.
Koala freezes mid-bite, looking toward the window with concern.
Dinosaur turns his head sharply toward the window with his mouth open in surprise.
Glaux spreads her wings slightly, looking alert toward the window.
Lukos's head and upper body appear in the window frame, grinning slyly with amber eyes gleaming.
The small square window with a wooden frame shows Lukos from outside.
motivations: Panda is startled and worried because she suddenly sees the threatening wolf at their window.
Koala is concerned and alert because Lukos appears unexpectedly during their peaceful meal.
Dinosaur is surprised and uneasy because the wolf's presence feels dangerous.
Glaux is watchful and tense because she spots the predator watching them.
Lukos is hungry and calculating because he sees the animals with food and plans to take it.

frames.text: οἴμοι! ὁ λύκος εἰσέρχεται διὰ τῆς θυρίδος εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν. τὰ καλὰ ζῷα φοβεῖται.
objects: a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden crust torn into pieces
a small square window with a wooden frame
positioning: Panda pushes back from the table in terror, preparing to run.
Koala scrambles backward from her seat with wide frightened eyes.
Dinosaur starts to rise from the table, looking panicked.
Glaux takes flight, wings spread as she moves away from the window.
Lukos climbs through the window into the room, his cloak flowing behind him.
The small square window with a wooden frame shows Lukos halfway through it.
motivations: Panda is panicking because Lukos is entering their safe home and she must escape.
Koala is terrified and retreating because the wolf is coming inside to threaten them.
Dinosaur is scared and preparing to flee because Lukos enters their peaceful house.
Glaux is alarmed and taking flight because the dangerous predator invades their space.
Lukos is determined and predatory because he wants the food and to frighten the animals.

frames.text: τὰ καλὰ ζῷα φεύγει ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας.
objects: a round rustic loaf of bread with a golden crust torn into pieces
positioning: Panda runs toward the door in the background, fleeing quickly.
Koala follows behind Panda, also running toward the exit.
Dinosaur rushes past the table toward the door, looking back fearfully.
Glaux flies rapidly toward the open doorway to escape.
Lukos stands by the window inside the house, watching them flee with satisfaction.
The round rustic loaf of bread with a golden crust torn into pieces remains abandoned on the table.
motivations: Panda is fleeing desperately because Lukos threatens her and her friends in their home.
Koala is running away in fear because the wolf has invaded and she needs safety.
Dinosaur is escaping quickly because Lukos scares him and he follows his friends.
Glaux is flying to safety because the predator forces her to abandon the meal.
Lukos is pleased and triumphant because he has successfully frightened away the animals and claimed their food.
